content.rationale: S3-status fixes the source and its width — the working-copy changed-path set, paths only, for recording's attribution; M-layout places the module flat at src/status.rs. It crosses `jj diff --summary -r @` (the machine-readable changed-path form S3-status names) and returns the paths, carrying failures as values with their evidence (S3-err); a rename is two changed paths, and `jj diff --summary` names them on one compact line — `R <prefix>{<old> => <new>}<suffix>`, the splice form included, or the brace-less pair — so the reader returns both. Deciding an edit's ownership is the record verb's concern.
